ref_text: THE UNCOUTH FACES PASSED HIM TWO BY TWO STAINED YELLOW OR RED OR LIVID BY THE SEA AND AS HE STROVE TO LOOK AT THEM WITH EASE AND INDIFFERENCE A FAINT STAIN OF PERSONAL SHAME AND COMMISERATION ROSE TO HIS OWN FACE
text: The uncouth faces past him two by two, stained yellow or red or live it by the sea, and as he strove to look at them with ease and indifference, a faint stain of personal shame and commiseration rose to his own face.
